*   **Surface:** Work on a large, flat table (wooden is best). Avoid carpet to prevent static electricity.
*   **Tools:** A magnetic Phillips-head screwdriver is usually all you need.
*   **Anti-Static:** Touch a metal part of your case occasionally to discharge static, or use an anti-static wrist strap.

#### 2. The "Outside the Case" Assembly
It is often easier to install the core components on the motherboard before putting it in the case. Place the motherboard on top of its own cardboard box.
